name: Sub-GHz Protocol Analysis
description: Ability to analyze the security of sub-GHz wireless protocols including LoRa/LoRaWAN, Zigbee, Z-Wave, ISM-band remotes, and proprietary IoT protocols operating below 1 GHz. Covers signal capture and decoding, protocol security assessment, key management evaluation, replay attack testing, and analysis of device join/pairing procedures.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to sub-GHz wireless protocol security analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common sub-GHz wireless protocols and their security properties
evidence: Can describe LoRa, Zigbee, and Z-Wave protocol architectures and their frequency bands
Understands ISM band regulations and common sub-GHz modulation schemes (OOK, FSK, CSS)
Completed training on sub-GHz wireless security and IoT protocol assessment

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Captures and decodes sub-GHz signals using standard tools under supervision
evidence: Captured and decoded OOK/FSK signals from ISM-band devices using RTL-SDR or HackRF under guidance
Used Zigbee sniffers (KillerBee, Wireshark/zbdump) to capture and decode Zigbee traffic under supervision
Performed replay attacks against simple sub-GHz remote controls in controlled lab exercises

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses sub-GHz protocol security across different protocol families
evidence: Independently assessed sub-GHz protocol security for 3+ different protocol types or device classes
Evaluated LoRaWAN join procedure security and session key management
Tested Zigbee network key provisioning and encryption implementation correctness
Produced reports documenting protocol weaknesses, replay attack susceptibility, and remediation guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Analyzes complex sub-GHz protocols; develops custom decoders; assesses key management at scale
evidence: Reverse-engineered proprietary sub-GHz IoT protocols and identified security flaws
Assessed LoRaWAN network server key management and ABP vs OTAA security implications at scale
Developed custom decoders and analysis tools for recurring sub-GHz protocol types
Mentors junior analysts on sub-GHz protocol assessment and tool development

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on sub-GHz protocol security; publishes research; defines lab methodology
evidence: Published research on sub-GHz protocol security vulnerabilities
Authored the lab's sub-GHz protocol assessment methodology
Discovered novel vulnerabilities in LoRa, Zigbee, Z-Wave, or proprietary sub-GHz protocols
Trains teams on sub-GHz protocol analysis and develops lab assessment infrastructure

assessment_methods.description: Assess the security of a sub-GHz IoT deployment: capture traffic, analyze protocol security, test for replay and key management weaknesses, and document findings
Review sub-GHz protocol assessment reports for protocol decoding accuracy and security analysis depth

equipment: Atmel RZUSBstick or ApiMote for Zigbee sniffing
